brand.tagline: The HR department of an AI company.

changePassword.title: Set a new password
changePassword.intro: This is your first sign-in. The starting password is single-use — set a password of your own.
changePassword.newHint: Use a long phrase that is easy for you to remember.
changePassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, or check the log if it keeps happening.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your network and try again.
errors.bad_response: The server returned data that could not be read.

auth.required: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
auth.csrf: The request was refused because the session did not match. Reload the page and try again.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.must_change_password: You need to change your password before continuing.
auth.invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
auth.locked: The account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts.
auth.weak_password: The new password is not strong enough.

password.too_short: The new password is too short. Use a longer phrase.
password.too_long: The new password is too long.
password.too_repetitive: The new password repeats too much. Use more different characters.
password.contains_username: The new password must not contain your username.
password.same_as_current: The new password must differ from the current one.

validation.failed: Some input is not valid. Check the fields and try again.

http.title: This connection is not encrypted.
http.body: You are using plain HTTP: passwords and sessions can be read on the network. Enable TLS at the edge (domain + HTTPS) before using this beyond this machine.
